response.sql: WITH scope_fees AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS scope, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate, COUNT(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS fee_count FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT scope, avg_net_fee_rate, fee_count, ABS(avg_net_fee_rate - (SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) FROM scope_fees)) AS distance_from_mean_scope_average FROM scope_fees;

assumptions.assumption: A fee with a NULL fee rate or rebate rate is excluded from its scope average and count; SQLite AVG and COUNT use only non-NULL net rates.
A NULL account scope, if present, forms its own group.
